# How would you find out which of `readr::read_csv()`'s arguments allows you to ignore the first N lines when reading a file?  

```{r}

install.packages("readr")
load.library("readr")
require("readr")
?read_csv()

```

```{r}

library(MASS)

mtcars |>
  select(mpg, cyl)
```

# How to change the date at the top of the html file this qmd renders to always be today's date?

date: today

# How to print this table more nicely?


```{r}

detach("package:MASS", unload=TRUE)
library(tibble)

mtcars |>
  rownames_to_column() |>
  select(rowname, mpg, cyl) |>
  slice(1:5)

```


# Fine the `data_processed_chocolatepoop.csv` file and load it, using only RStudio

Ensure this qmd file is in `exercises/`!

```{r}

list.dirs("../data/processed",
          full.names = FALSE,
          recursive = FALSE)
list.files("../data/processed")

file.exists("../data/processed/data_processed_chocolatepoop.csv")
dat <- read_csv("../data/processed/data_processed_chocolatepoop.csv")

```
